title: Mitochondrial Genetic Diseases and Ophthalmic Manifestations: Molecular Pathophysiology, Genetics, and Clinical Management.

outcomes.name: mechanism-based treatment of ophthalmic manifestations
outcomes.effect_text: Treatment remains largely supportive, but idebenone, gene therapy, mitophagy modulation, and targeted antioxidants now offer mechanism-based intervention for several ophthalmic manifestations
